Alexander Tvaladze describes a Russian version of the commerce game known as три палки (Three Sticks), a variant of the Schwimmen (31) family. The 31/commerce group is popular in Germany, Austria, and Russia; this Russian variant uses a 36-card pack and stick penalties for the lowest hand.
36 cards (6-A). Values: A=11, K=4, Q=3, J=2, 10=-10, 9=0, 6-8=Face value.
